title: Juicy Citrusy Macaroni Stir-fry
description: A mediterranean-friendly weeknight dish featuring juicy macaroni stir-fried with citrus flavors and other Mediterranean ingredients.

ingredients.name: lemon juice
ingredients.notes: freshly squeezed for best flavor and aroma

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: extra virgin olive oil is recommended

ingredients.name: red pepper flakes
ingredients.notes: optional, to add heat if desired

ingredients.name: parsley
ingredients.notes: fresh parsley adds a bright and flavorful touch

ingredients.name: zucchini
ingredients.notes: optional, to add more vegetables for added nutrition and texture

instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions until al dente.
In a large skillet or wok, heat olive oil over medium-high heat. Add red pepper flakes if using.
Add garlic and sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant but not browned.
Add cherry tomatoes and cook for another minute, stirring occasionally.
Stir in cooked macaroni with a splash of lemon juice and toss to coat evenly.
If adding zucchini, add now along with more lemon juice. Cook for an additional 2 minutes until vegetables are just tender.
Fold in chopped parsley just before serving for a burst of freshness.
Serve hot as a side dish or over a bed of greens.
